parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of trans identity and no organised police sweeps, and federal hate-crime recourse and functioning courts exist (some national orders enjoined). But two traveller-facing exposures dominate. First, the national border/document regime is a universal exposure with no working remedy: X markers eliminated, discrepancy-based refusals, case-note tags, and possible lifetime fraud findings, with documented passport confiscations, stranded travellers and at least eight governments' advisories after detentions. Second, the state bans gender-congruent facilities in K-12 and, by executive order, state-owned buildings, shelters and custody, with courts upholding such rules and no state accommodation protections. Custody conditions (national corrections and immigration detention) are documented as harmful including sexual abuse. Social hostility is real (66% back birth-sex markers) but friction-level in ordinary commerce; the facilities and border exposures, enforced by institutions, carry the rating into the Elevated band.
